evidence.text: Unique Item: The Veiled Eye; Availability: Unique; Effect and Burden: Aeldari spirit-lens. Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute, you can see Invisible and Hidden creatures within 60 ft, cannot be Surprised, and your ranged attacks ignore Light Cover. Burden: The item carries a psychic echo noticeable to Aeldari and Warp-sensitive beings.
